extras: Audio generation can take several minutes depending on content length.
intentEvidence: This project allows you to create text-to-speech audio files using the Eleven Labs api, straight from your Obsidian notes.
problem: Users need a way to convert written notes directly into audio files for listening or accessibility within Obsidian.
summary: A text-to-speech plugin that uses the Eleven Labs API to convert highlighted text in Obsidian notes into downloadable audio files.
